{{Top|leg}}
'''Channel 5''' (also known as '''tac-fiver''') was a transmission frequency use by [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[TIE pilot|pilots]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. This frequency allowed [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to receive transmissions from their squad leaders before a mission commenced. Because it was a low-powered channel with a limited range, it allowed pilots to communicate without enemy interception. It also allowed for pilots to communicate without being overheard by the [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]] on their home chip, as long as the squad was a far enough distance away.
